newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp says plans to boost LCD output capacity.
newsitem.headline: Sharp says plans to boost LCD output capacity.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Tuesday that it plans to boost its capacity to produce large liquid crystal displays (LCDs) by the spring.
"We are planning to boost capacity by spring 1997, but the value of the investment and other details have not been set," a Sharp spokesman said.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Tuesday that Sharp would invest about 10 billion yen in its plant in Mie Prefecture in central Japan to boost its capacity to produce thin-film-transistor LCDs by about 30 percent by the spring.
